tools.name: get_project
tools.summary: Get a readable summary of the current edit (assets, clips with timeline times, layers, audio, captions) plus validation issues.

tools.name: new_project
tools.summary: Start a new empty project (discarding the current one; undo restores it).

tools.name: set_project_settings
tools.summary: Change resolution/aspect ratio, frame rate, background color or name.

tools.name: undo
tools.summary: Undo the last edit.

tools.name: redo
tools.summary: Redo the last undone edit.

tools.name: review_edit
tools.summary: Check the edit for what a viewer notices, with timeline times, without changing anything.

tools.name: offer_choices
tools.summary: Let the user choose when taste decides, instead of deciding for them: a narration voice (play the files preview_voice made), a music track, a sound...

tools.name: search_files
tools.summary: Find the user's own media and documents on this computer by name: videos, music, photos, and text documents (scripts, notes, subtitles).

tools.name: read_document
tools.summary: Read a text document the user keeps (a script, notes, a shot list, subtitles), from the folders they allow or from the project, to follow it in the...

tools.name: copy_to_project
tools.summary: Copy media the user keeps on this computer (from search_files) into the project, and add it as an asset ready for add_clip, add_audio or...

tools.name: remember
tools.summary: Remember something for later requests: about the user in general (a style they like, their brand colors, their channel, how they want captions) or...

tools.name: forget
tools.summary: Forget something you remembered, by its id (shown in brackets in what you remember), when it is wrong or the user asks.

tools.name: propose_plan
tools.summary: Propose an edit plan for the user to approve before you change anything: for big or open requests (a full edit from raw footage, a restyle), or...

tools.name: list_templates
tools.summary: Browse video templates (styles to edit toward).

tools.name: get_template
tools.summary: Read a template's brief: required inputs (slots), scenes, look, and guidance on how to edit footage to match it.

tools.name: apply_template
tools.summary: Build a new edit from a template and inputs (replaces the current project; undo restores it).

tools.name: list_effects
tools.summary: List available visual effects (color grades, retouch, bokeh and blur, light, zooms and motion, shakes, stylize) with their parameters.

tools.name: list_audio_effects
tools.summary: List audio effects (noise reduction, voice enhancement, EQ, dynamics, loudness, reverb, pitch, robot, telephone…) with their parameters.

tools.name: list_transitions
tools.summary: List transitions usable between primary-track clips.

tools.name: list_animations
tools.summary: List entrance/exit animations for text, shape and media layers.

tools.name: list_caption_styles
tools.summary: List caption style presets (bold-pop, karaoke, word-by-word, boxed, cinematic…).

tools.name: list_components
tools.summary: List reusable components (lower-third, title-card, CTA, subscribe button, quote, number badge, countdown…) and their params.

tools.name: import_media
tools.summary: Add a video, audio or image file to the project's assets (probes duration, size and audio).

tools.name: add_clip
tools.summary: Add a clip to the primary track (clips play back-to-back).

tools.name: update_clip
tools.summary: Change properties of a primary-track clip (in, duration, speed, volume, muted, fit, effects, audioEffects, transition, fadeIn, fadeOut, audioLead...

tools.name: remove_clip
tools.summary: Delete a clip from the primary track.

tools.name: move_clip
tools.summary: Reorder a clip on the primary track.

tools.name: split_clip
tools.summary: Split a primary clip in two at a timeline time (seconds).

tools.name: trim_clip
tools.summary: Set a clip's source in/out points (seconds in the original media).

tools.name: split_edit
tools.summary: Make a J or L cut at the cut into a primary clip, so sound and picture change at different moments (standard in interviews and talking heads).

tools.name: freeze_frame
tools.summary: Hold one frame of the video still for a few seconds (a freeze-frame, e.g. for a 'that's me' title or a dramatic beat).

tools.name: set_speed
tools.summary: Speed up or slow down a primary clip or an audio clip (0.25-4; 0.5 = half speed slow motion, 2 = double speed).

tools.name: speed_ramp
tools.summary: Change a clip's speed over time: fast, then slow motion on the moment that matters, then back (a speed ramp).

tools.name: set_transition
tools.summary: Set the transition into a clip (or between all clips with all=true).

tools.name: add_effect
tools.summary: Add an effect to a clip, a media layer, or the whole video (target 'global').

tools.name: remove_effect
tools.summary: Remove an effect from a clip, media layer or 'global': by type (the whole-frame one first), or by label for a masked effect such as a grade_region...

tools.name: animate_effect

tools.name: retouch
tools.summary: Retouch people in a clip, a media layer, every clip, or the whole video.

tools.name: detect_faces
tools.summary: Find and follow the faces in primary clips (or in a source asset), on this machine (a small model downloads once).

tools.name: reframe
tools.summary: Point each clip's crop at the person in it, for fit cover when the source shape differs from the video (16:9 footage in a 9:16 video).

tools.name: follow_face

tools.name: add_text
tools.summary: Add a text layer (titles, labels, callouts).

tools.name: add_media_overlay
tools.summary: Overlay a video or image (picture-in-picture, b-roll cutaway, logo).

tools.name: add_shape

tools.name: add_component
tools.summary: Insert a reusable component (lower-third, title-card, cta, subscribe, hook-text, quote, number-badge, countdown, label, end-screen…) at a time.

tools.name: update_layer
tools.summary: Change a layer's properties (text, start, duration, position, style, size, opacity, animations…).

tools.name: reorder_layer
tools.summary: Change which layer draws on top.

tools.name: remove_layer
tools.summary: Delete a layer (text, media overlay or shape).

tools.name: animate_layer
tools.summary: Move, scale, turn or fade a layer over time with keyframes (text, shapes and media overlays): a label that slides along with a product, a logo that...

tools.name: create_graphic
tools.summary: Design your own graphic in SVG and put it on the video: lower thirds, title cards, styled or 3D-looking text, UI mockups (app screens, notifications...

tools.name: update_graphic
tools.summary: Redraw a graphic made with create_graphic from new SVG (read the current SVG on its asset with get_project), or redraw it for a new duration.

tools.name: search_icons
tools.summary: Find icons for feature callouts, lists and lower thirds (the Lucide set, about 1,600 line icons, free to use).

tools.name: add_icon
tools.summary: Put an icon on screen (see search_icons for names), drawn sharp at any size like text, optionally on a round or rounded badge.

tools.name: list_fonts
tools.summary: List the font families text can use: the ones added with install_font, the bundled ones (Arimo, Archivo Black, Gelasio, Anton, Cousine, Comic Neue...

tools.summary: Add a font from Google Fonts (all open-licensed, free for video), e.g. 'Montserrat', 'Bebas Neue', 'Playfair Display', 'Inter', 'Anton'.

tools.name: install_fonts
tools.summary: Install many Google Fonts families at once: whole packs and/or a list of families.

tools.name: make_thumbnail
tools.summary: Make a thumbnail image (YouTube style: a frame of the video, punchier color, a big bold title of 2-5 words).

tools.name: add_audio
tools.summary: Add music, voice-over or a sound effect.

tools.name: update_audio
tools.summary: Change an audio clip (volume, speed, start, fades, duck, loop, audioEffects…).

tools.name: remove_audio
tools.summary: Delete an audio clip.

tools.name: set_volume
tools.summary: Set the volume of a primary clip, an audio clip, a media layer, or the whole mix (target "master").

tools.name: enhance_audio

tools.name: add_audio_effect
tools.summary: Add an audio effect to a primary clip, an audio clip, a media layer, or the final mix (target "master").

tools.name: remove_audio_effect
tools.summary: Remove an audio effect (by type) from a clip, audio clip, media layer or "master".

tools.name: detect_scenes
tools.summary: Find shot changes (cuts between camera angles or scenes) in a video asset.

tools.name: detect_beats
tools.summary: Find the tempo and beat times of music: an audio clip (times on the timeline) or an asset (source times).

tools.name: beat_sync
tools.summary: Edit to the music's beat.

tools.name: add_sound_effect
tools.summary: Add a sound effect at timeline moments where something visibly happens: a pop when text appears, an impact on a reveal, a riser ending on a drop.

tools.name: transcribe
tools.summary: Transcribe an asset's speech with word timings.

tools.name: set_transcript
tools.summary: Attach a transcript to an asset from SRT, VTT, Whisper/Deepgram/AssemblyAI JSON, or {words:[{text,start,end}]}.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.summary: Read an asset's transcript as timestamped sentences (source time) with speaking stats.

tools.name: search_transcript
tools.summary: Find where a phrase is said.

tools.name: cleanup_speech
tools.summary: Tighten talking-head footage using its transcript: cut filler words (um, uh…), stutters and long pauses.

tools.name: cut_ranges
tools.summary: Remove time ranges from the finished timeline (timeline seconds).

tools.name: assemble_from_source
tools.summary: Rebuild the primary track from chosen source ranges of one asset, in the order given (e.g. pick the best moments of a long recording by transcript).

tools.name: set_captions
tools.summary: Turn captions on/off and pick a style (see list_caption_styles).

tools.name: export_captions
tools.summary: Write the captions as a subtitle sidecar file (srt, vtt or ass), e.g. for YouTube upload.

tools.name: preview_voice
tools.summary: Speak a sample line in one or more voices and save each as a WAV file to listen to and compare, without changing the project.

tools.name: set_voice
tools.summary: Set the project's narration voice and speed, used by generate_voiceover and revoice when no voice is given.

tools.name: generate_voiceover
tools.summary: Synthesize narration from text and add it as a voice-over with measured word timings for captions.

tools.name: revoice
tools.summary: Re-generate narration already in the project with a new voice, speed or wording, keeping each voice-over where it is on the timeline.

tools.name: color_adjust
tools.summary: Color correct and grade a clip, a media layer, every clip, or the whole video.

tools.name: get_color
tools.summary: Read the current color settings of a target ("global", a clip id, or a media layer id).

tools.summary: Make clips look like a reference clip, so shots from different cameras or lighting cut together.
